summary.text: Tom Ploszaj is a Republican state representative from Belknap 1 who has served in the House since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Ploszaj was born in Terryville, Connecticut, and earned an associate degree from WSTC-UConn in 1990.

According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes work as an emergency medical technician, in analytic research science and in agriculture and animal husbandry, and with General Motors and Crompton Corp.
He has served with the Civil Air Patrol, the Lions Club, and volunteer ambulance and fire departments in Plymouth, Winsted and Grafton.
Ploszaj was assigned to the House Science, Technology and Energy Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He faces Democrat Amber Schaefer in the November 3, 2026 general election.
